text: DSH Extension Center 是面向 DSH Web 的扩展管理插件，通过 Host Connection RPC 和浏览器侧边栏入口连接目录与管理界面。它提供插件、MCP 连接和 Skills 的目录搜索、详情筛选、已安装项目查看、更新与配置流程，并在执行生命周期变更前展示计划供用户审阅。目录支持离线启动并可按配置刷新；适合希望在 DSH 内集中发现和管理扩展的用户。源码未显示需要额外 API 密钥。

DSH Extension Center adds a DSH Web sidebar to manage plugins, MCP connections, and Skills. Users can search the catalog, view installed items, configure extensions, and review changes. It can use an offline catalog or refresh a configured endpoint; reviewed source shows no API-key requirement.

Can I review installed extensions and manage their configuration and updates in one place?
DSH Extension Center 的功能「扩展目录浏览」：在 Web 侧边栏打开中心后，用户可搜索目录，并按类型、范围、配置、权限或生命周期状态筛选条目。
DSH Extension Center 的功能「已安装扩展管理」：Installed 面板按范围读取库存，展示扩展状态，并提供可用的配置、启用、停用、恢复或卸载操作入口。
DSH Extension Center 的功能「变更计划审阅」：选择目录条目的生命周期操作后，界面向管理服务请求预览，再显示计划审阅面板，供用户确认或取消。

dsh-plugin-extension-center README · DSH Extension Center：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

An independent Host+Web plugin for the official DeepSeek Harness. It adds one Extension Center without changing or forking DSH.
dsh-plugin-extension-center README · Product scope：The Center gives users and Agents one managed path for Plugin, MCP connection, and Skill capabilities:

dsh-plugin-extension-center README · Product scope：The Agent may identify and rank candidates autonomously, but it cannot supply package coordinates, URLs, commands, credentials, or approval to a mutation tool. The Host resolves those facts from the signed catalog and current inventory; a user grants each concrete write separately.

dsh-plugin-extension-center README · Compatibility target：The current reviewed target is the unmodified official DSH `0.1.2-alpha.3`, tag `dsh-v0.1.2-alpha.3`, commit `dd6322d604e00eec1ba5e0c8541159906a21094a`. The plugin uses the public Bundle patch, Host Connection RPC, Client Connection RPC, and Web slot contracts exposed by that release.

dsh-plugin-extension-center README · Compatibility target：Publishing this plugin to npm is not a completion requirement. The supported delivery artifact is the deterministic tarball produced by this repository and installed with the standard official Plugin CLI. Official DSH remains an external, unmodified dependency.

dsh-plugin-extension-center README · Install like a user：Install the current official DSH and ensure `pnpm` is on `PATH`:

```sh
pnpm add --global @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.3
```

Download or build the GitHub-hosted Center tarball, then install it through the ordinary Plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-plugin-extension-center-0.2.0-alpha.1.tgz --ignore-scripts --save-exact
dsh web
```

For a source checkout, create the same user-facing artifact without installing the source tree into DSH:

dsh-plugin-extension-center README · Install like a user：```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build
pnpm run verify:pack
```

The tarball is written under `.artifacts/release-candidate/`. Until a registry channel exists, update by adding the exact newer tarball; removal uses the same official Profile package manager:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-plugin-extension-center-NEWER.tgz --ignore-scripts --save-exact
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-extension-center
```

dsh-plugin-extension-center README · Verification：```sh
pnpm test
pnpm run verify:pack
pnpm run test:compat:latest
```

`test:compat:latest` builds and packs the Center, installs it into an isolated official DSH `0.1.2-alpha.3` Web Profile with the standard Plugin CLI, boots the real Host and browser Client, verifies the Store surface and Connection RPC, and checks that the official DSH package tree is unchanged. Its receipt is written to `.artifacts/acceptance/store-only/receipt.json`.

dsh-plugin-extension-center README · Verification：The packaged signed revision 11 catalog is historical rc.2 data and remains immutable. It is safe for offline inspection but is not silently relabelled as alpha.3-compatible. Exact alpha.3 child-candidate lifecycle claims require their own reviewed, signed admission receipt; until then the UI fails closed for mutation. This does not block proving that the independent Center itself installs and runs on the latest official DSH.
